behavior: Provide a persistent PostgreSQL task queue with enqueue, lease, acknowledge and retry semantics that survives process crash without losing or double-delivering committed tasks.
nonGoals: No adapter, transport or evidence code path changes
No planning, requirement or catalog edits
notes: protectedTests HAR-002 is the catalog suite covering HAR-003, HAR-004, HAR-005, HAR-006 and HAR-010 (verification/test-catalog.json); per CP-002's ruling this suite will be re-cut into per-requirement sub-suites, and this contract cites the current catalog entry pending that amendment. runnerDigest is the attested G0 runner image pending a G1 runner attestation; task-ready v1 does not verify runnerDigest or testSourceDigest. testSourceDigest is the oracle-input digest of structile-conformance main 46c8cf99cbac5d0c87729e08db20bbadbe2bacd0, computed by calling the runner's own runnerDigests() in src/evidence.ts directly rather than invented. @structile/agent-harness currently declares zero runtime dependencies; a persistent PostgreSQL task queue needs a client library, so allowedPaths adds packages/agent-harness/package.json plus root package-lock.json (listed in generatedPaths, excluded from line-count as a reproducible lockfile companion per the schema); if HAR-003-T01 has already landed and added the same dependency, this task's package.json/package-lock.json diff is expected to be a no-op. No shared db-test-helper convention exists yet anywhere in this repo; tests reach PostgreSQL via the same STRUCTILE_POSTGRES_HOST/STRUCTILE_POSTGRES_PORT env-var convention as HAR-003-T01, brought up with a compose step adapted from the README's STRUCTILE_DEV_POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE convention (postgres service only, detached), so no path outside packages/agent-harness/** plus the two dependency-declaration files is needed.
